title: Git & GitHub
tagline: Understand version history, collaboration, and software change
summary: Git is a distributed version-control system for recording, comparing, branching, merging, and recovering changes in a codebase. GitHub builds collaboration, review, automation, and project workflows around Git. This book takes you from snapshots, commits, and the staging area through branches, merges, rebases, remotes, pull requests, conflicts, recovery, release workflows, CI/CD, security, and team architecture. By the end you'll understand not just which Git command to type, but what Git is actually storing and how professional teams use version control to control change.
